fields.name: Fade
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2D112F0 copy-constructs it (ls::STDString::STDString) from the string of the user's entry in esv::timeline::FadeInTimeoutSingletonComponent - the id of the screen fade to clear. Game struct name (macOS): esv::timeline::ClearFadeRequest.

fields.name: Duration
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2D112F0 stores the value of the system's per-user map (filled from esv::timeline::TimelineFadeClearRequestOneFrameComponent+4, 0.5) or, on timeout, the constant 0.2 (Toolkit: esv::timeline::FadeSystem::c_TimeoutClearScreenDuration). Toolkit ProcessClearScreenFadeRequests copies it as the first float, which becomes ScreenFadeData.Duration.

fields.name: WaitTime
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2D112F0 writes 0. Toolkit esv::screen_fade::ScreenFadeSystem::ProcessClearScreenFadeRequests (EoCServer.dll+0x39CF30) copies +0x18 and +0x1C of each element into the two float members of its own ClearScreenFadeRequest (LEGACY_ClearScreenFadeRequest(name, float, float, user)), which FinalizeComponents writes to eoc::screen_fade::ScreenFadeData Duration (+0x18) and WaitTime (+0x1C).

fields.name: User
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2D112F0 stores the 4-byte key of the per-user map / of the timeout map.

fields.name: Requests
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2D112F0 (~esv::timeline::FadeSystem::ProcessClearScreenFades) builds a local array with element stride 0x28 and, when it is not empty, creates the component on a new entity (bg3.exe+0x2D12040) and moves pointer, capacity and size into +0/+8/+0xC.

open_questions: Duration / WaitTime are named after the eoc::screen_fade::ScreenFadeData members they end up in (Toolkit chain ProcessClearScreenFadeRequests -> FinalizeComponents); the Windows copy of that chain was not read.
second_pass: Windows bg3.exe+0x2D112F0 gives every offset and width of the 0x28-byte esv::timeline::ClearFadeRequest; the Toolkit consumer ProcessClearScreenFadeRequests maps +0x18/+0x1C to the fade's Duration/WaitTime and +0x20 to the user. STDString is a builtin of generate.py now (24 bytes), so the earlier external_types override was removed.
